general: Follow the 'Dark Mode Admin' aesthetic strictly.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Public Sans' for body text.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for IDs, JSON, and LaTeX code blocks.
Implement the 'Status Colors' faithfully for paper and question statuses.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use the defined spacing scale; avoid magic numbers.
For the 'YearSpec Review', use a split-pane layout (PDF/Evidence on left, Form on right).
For 'Question Review', use a master-detail view or a side-sheet for editing.
Validate inputs rigorously before 'LOCK' status transition.
Use Shadcn UI components as the base but apply the custom styles defined here.
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds; stick to solid dark colors with subtle borders.

files.tailwind_config: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom font families and color palette extensions.
files.global_css: Update index.css to import the fonts and set the base styles.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays can be used for 'empty states' or '404 pages' only.
